Here is a truth nobody tells you. Your child feeds off your energy. When you are anxious and depleted, they feel it. So healing starts with you. Every week you will get biblical encouragement and healing declarations to settle your spirit, plus the practical strategies to become your child's fiercest advocate.

I teach it through my Root Cause Self-Assessment, a simple framework I built from twenty years in risk management and used on my own daughter's case. You will learn to recognize what changed and when, catalog what has and has not been tested, search for the root causes nobody looked for like PANS and PANDAS, gut inflammation, and heavy metals, and act on one clear next step at a time.

I'm Twana, a mom and former risk management executive who treated my daughter's diagnosis like a case to solve. On day two of the protocol I built, she said Mama.

Grab your prayer journal and your lab reports. Scriptures for the hard days, root cause answers, and the faith to trust God again while you wait for your breakthrough. New episodes weekly.

This podcast is for encouragement and education, not medical advice. Always work with your child's doctor.

title: The 2nd Shift Podcast
author: the2ndshiftpodcast6
description:
Why Second Shift? 🚒🎙️

Because the shift doesn't always end when they come home.

There's the shift everyone sees, the calls, the adrenaline, the interrupted sleep, the repeated exposure to trauma. And then there's the second shift: walking through the door and trying to transition from first responder to spouse, from firefighter to parent, from hyper-alert to present. Sometimes within minutes, before anyone's had time to process what the last shift actually was.

The people waiting at home are navigating it too.

That's Second Shift — our name for the space between the uniform and home. The invisible transition emergency workers and their families make over and over, that doesn't always get talked about.

This project was born from our own story, but we know it isn't only ours. We want to give language to what families experience but haven't known how to explain trauma, sleep deprivation, marriage, parenting, identity, mental health, and what it takes to build a healthy life alongside a job that asks so much.

Not to vilify the job, or diminish the pride and brotherhood that come with it. Just to make room for the other side of the story.

Because sometimes the hardest shift is the one nobody sees.

Welcome to Second Shift. 🚒🎙️❤️

#SecondShiftPodcast #FirefighterLife #FirefighterFamily #FirstResponderMentalHealth #FireService

title: Lord, Is This a Test or a Man? with Carmel Browne
author: Carmel Browne
description:
Carmel Browne has spent 30 years as a licensed clinical social worker doing therapy, psychiatric assessments, crisis work, and listening to people lie to her face for a living. After three decades of studying human behavior, she has developed a fairly low tolerance for bullshit — professionally or otherwise.


Now she’s turning that trained eye toward the things we’d sometimes rather not examine too closely: the men we date, the red flags we baptize, the trauma we mistake for chemistry, the culture moments everybody is arguing about, and the stories we tell ourselves so we can stay in situations we probably should have left three exits ago.


Carmel is licensed in six states and holds multiple clinical and professional credentials, including LICSW, LCSW, LISW-CP, CSTIP, CCTP-II, CMDP, CGP, and CFI. Her work spans behavioral health, therapy, psychiatric assessment, clinical leadership, and the complicated business of figuring out why human beings keep doing the shit they do.


She is the author of the upcoming book Lord, Is This a Test or a Man? — a funny, clinical, occasionally profane look at relationships, attachment, red flags, boundaries, and what happens when very smart women temporarily misplace several functioning brain cells because a man is fine.


Licensed in six states. Unfiltered in all fifty.


And every episode asks some version of the same question:


Lord… is this a test, or is this a man?

title: Kidnapping Secrets

description:
Kidnapping changes the geometry of a life in seconds: a car door slams, a barn goes dark, a shoe holds a note nobody was supposed to find. That single object, that one desperate act, becomes the thread investigators pull on for days, sometimes years, before anyone gets an answer about how the kidnapping actually unfolded.

This show rebuilds those kidnapping cases from the inside out. Each episode is one complete story, narrated without a host in the room, reconstructed from police reports, court transcripts, and the accounts of the people who lived through it. You hear how a crossword clue cracked open a kidnapping case after eleven days of silence, how a scribbled note saved a man locked inside a barn, how a girl hidden in plain sight got herself found alive after four days by writing three words no one thought to check. These are not summaries. They are slow, detailed walks through fear, improvisation, and the small, strange decisions that meant the difference between rescue and disappearance.

Expect the full range of what kidnapping actually looks like: strangers and family members, ransom plots gone wrong, abductions that made national news and ones that almost slipped through the cracks entirely. You will hear from survivors directly when their words exist on record, and from the detectives who read a room, a ransom note, or a single misplaced clue correctly enough to bring someone home. This is true crime built on documentation, not speculation, focused on the mechanics of captivity and the exact moment escape from kidnapping became possible.

If you are drawn to kidnapping cases that reward close attention, stories where one detail unravels everything, this is built for you. New episodes drop weekly. Subscribe so you never miss the next case, and follow along as one story at a time gets told the way it actually happened.

description:
Create easy life-giving rhythms for your home!
*Do you wish you could finally implement the things you know you ”should” do but can’t seem to keep doing in order to peacefully manage your home?
*Are you unmotivated, frustrated, and disappointed in yourself because you feel you continually fall short, repeatedly fail, and are ”never enough”? 
*Do you just crave some breathing room from the physical and mental clutter in your life?
Hi, I’m Cindy--married over forty years, mom to eight, and veteran homeschooler for thirty years. Most importantly, I’m a daughter of the Most High. Still, running our home during those years of child-raising was a challenge, and I didn’t always do it well.
I read the books, went to the seminars, listened to the programs, but nothing seemed to work for me and our particular family. I did the systems, worked the 3x5 cards, and filled out the planners. But sometimes I would miss a day (or a week), and the house would descend into chaos, the self-condemnation would roll in, and the tears would flow. Afraid I would ruin everything and everyone by my poor habits and therefore fail in my God-given responsibilities to honor my husband and raise children who loved the Lord, I would shout to myself, ”I’ve GOT to get a handle on this!”
Finally, I saw that the pressure of the world--even the Christian culture--was stronger than I had realized, and that I simply was not created to be like anyone else. Although tips and hints helped in managing our home, what eventually worked long-term was discovering that God made me to be ME--unique in demeanor, thinking, and capability--and that I was most at peace when I consciously incorporated that uniqueness into my everyday life with my one-of-a-kind family.
I found that I could simply many household tasks, respect my husband, and nurture our children all while living in personal peace and quietness. Today, my life runs on rhythms of grace and thanksgiving--absent of pressure, comparison, and condemnation. Anxiety and fear are banished, and I am free to abide in His daily care for me. What a life!
If you are ready to create order in your home with simple strategies, grow spiritually to hear God’s voice in the everyday, and discover personal peace through His abounding grace, then come on in. You are welcome here.
So, put the kettle on and brew your favorite tea; let’s visit awhile.

Whether you are supporting a parent, partner, child, friend, or other loved one, this channel helps you face the realities that often go unspoken: managing the cost of care, advocating within a complex healthcare system, protecting your own well-being, and finding moments of hope amid the pressure.

You are not alone, and help should not be out of reach.

Hosted by brand strategist, creative director, and Lex Creative Studios founder Alexis Campbell, the show explores what it means to build a brand that reflects who you’ve become, what you’re called to build, and where God is leading you next.


We’ll talk branding, positioning, creative strategy, visibility, reinvention, thought leadership, and design — all through the lens of faith.


These conversations are for the woman who has already built something meaningful, but somewhere along the way, her brand began to feel out of step with the depth of her work and the direction she’s headed.

Each week, Alexis will help you understand what’s changing, get clearer about the foundation beneath your brand, and make stronger decisions about how you position yourself, communicate your work, show up, and grow.


Your next chapter doesn’t require you to become someone else. It requires a brand that fully reflects who you already are.


You know you’re called to the work. Now let’s get you branded for what’s next!

title: Cipher
author: Sami Ahraf
description:
Cipher tells the true stories of espionage and codebreaking — the trade of secrets, and the mathematics of keeping them. Each episode, host Nirob takes one operation, one machine, or one traitor — a telegram that dragged America into a world war, a body washed ashore in Spain carrying deliberately false plans, a machine with rotors that its owners believed unbreakable and a hut full of people who broke it anyway, a man at the top of British intelligence who had been working for Moscow the whole time — and rebuilds it: the stakes, the tradecraft, the tiny slip that gave it away, and what it cost.

From a queen's letters read by her enemies to the public-key mathematics protecting every message you send today, from a corpse with a briefcase to a bug with no batteries hidden in a gift from Moscow, Cipher is the history of the twentieth century told sideways — through decrypts, dead drops, and the people who lived double lives. Meticulously researched, honest about what remains classified, and always clear about the difference between the record and the legend. Clean and suitable for all ages. A new secret every week

title: 21st Precinct

description:
.The Echoes of "21st Precinct": A Look Back at the Classic Police Drama
Step back in time to the bustling streets of New York City in the 1950s, where the airwaves were filled with the gripping tales of "21st Precinct," a police drama that captivated listeners with its authentic portrayal of the men in blue. From July 7, 1953, to July 26, 1956, CBS radio audiences were treated to this innovative series that was not just entertainment but a tribute to the real heroes of the city.
"21st Precinct" was more than just a show; it was a summer sensation that replaced "My Friend Irma," offering a unique glimpse into the lives of New York's finest. Produced in collaboration with the Patrolmen's Benevolent Association of the City of New York, the series presented stories adapted from true criminal records, all from the perspective of the police, the unsung guardians of the city.
The show was a masterful creation of Stanley Niss, who wore the hats of producer, writer, and director, bringing to life the stories of bravery, sacrifice, and the pursuit of justice. The precinct, though fictional and without a real-world counterpart after the reorganization in 1929, resonated with the listeners, symbolizing the law and order that the actual 23rd Precinct represented.
Everett Sloane's portrayal of Captain Frank Kennelly was nothing short of iconic, embodying the leadership and dedication of a precinct captain. His character's promotion and reassignment marked a significant turn in the series, paving the way for actors James Gregory and Les Damon to step in as Captain Cronin, continuing the legacy of leadership.
The ensemble cast, including Ken Lynch, Harold Stone, Jack Orissa, and Santos Ortega, brought depth and authenticity to the show, making each character memorable and each episode a narrative gem. The opening lines of the announcer, followed by the lead actor's introduction, set the stage for the drama that would unfold, immersing the audience in the heart of the 21st Precinct.
Today, "21st Precinct" remains a testament to the golden age of radio, a period when storytelling was an auditory art form, and the imagination was the canvas. It reminds us of the timeless nature of good storytelling and the enduring respect for those who protect and serve. As we celebrate the legacy of this classic series, we honor the real-life counterparts of the characters who continue to watch over the city, ensuring the security of its people. The 21st Precinct may be a memory, but the spirit of service it depicted lives on.

title: Call Sign Condor: Latino Soldiers Fighting in Ukraine
author: DW, LA Times Studios, Futuro Studios
description:
Why would someone decide to risk their life for a country that is not their own? What might they be searching for? From LA Times Studios and DW, in collaboration with Futuro Studios, Call Sign Condor is a podcast about the thousands of Latin American soldiers who are fighting in Ukraine —  for Ukraine. Through the stories of our protagonist, Condor, and his fellow soldiers, this four-part podcast series takes us inside the lives of Latin American men and women who’ve been fighting — some of them for years — in the war in Ukraine. Through their experiences of fear, loss, and belonging — even falling in love — host Carolina Chimoy explores what brought these soldiers to the front, how they’ve experienced the war, and what they've found there.
Carolina Chimoy is an international correspondent at DW’s headquarters in Berlin, currently covering the war in Ukraine. She previously served as DW’s U.S. correspondent in Washington, D.C., reporting on the White House, national security, and transatlantic relations.
Over the course of her career, Carolina has reported extensively from across Latin America, covering presidential elections in Brazil, Peru and Bolivia, as well as major political developments in the region. 
For this podcast, after realizing just how many Latinos have come to fight in this war in Ukraine, Carolina has immersed herself in the world of these soldiers. She’s observed not only how they live with a war that is not their own, but also how they have adapted to Ukrainian society, its climate and its culture.
Through Condor and other soldiers’ personal stories, she takes us into the reality of the trenches, but also into deeply human moments of relief and even happiness each has found. At the same time, she shows how these soldiers are also changing the lives of Ukrainians in their own country.

poundersquest.com

description: This healing podcast explores the journey of emotional wellness, self-growth, and resilience. Featuring honest discussions, practical tools, and expert insights, each episode helps listeners process pain, build healthy coping skills, and cultivate self-compassion. Healing isn’t linear—and you don’t have to walk the path alone.

title: Puzzle Pieces Podcast
author: Puzzle Pieces Podcast
description:
The Puzzle Pieces Podcast brings honest conversations, practical guidance, and trusted resources to individuals with disabilities, families, caregivers, and the people who support them.
Hosted by the team at Puzzle Pieces, each episode explores topics that matter—from diagnosis, education, therapies, behavior, and advocacy to independence, employment, relationships, community resources, and life beyond services.
Our goal is simple: to help families feel informed, supported, and connected while creating greater understanding around disability in our community.

title: Better at Home with Myf Warhurst
author: Better Homes and Garden Real Estate Australia
description:
Better at Home is a video podcast about people who've built a home, and a life, that fits them. Some wanted more room to work with. Others were after something harder to pin down, the particular place that suited how they wanted to live.
Across six episodes, Myf Warhurst spends time in their homes and gardens and gets into the property journey behind each one, how they found the place and made it their own.
Brought to you by Better Homes and Gardens Real Estate Australia. Nobody knows homes better.

title: The Quiet Hour
author: Derek Bowen
description: Quiet Hour is a calm, reflective porch‑night broadcast created in Hagerstown, Maryland. Each episode blends atmospheric storytelling, meteorological perspective, and quiet cosmic imagery to create a steady end‑of‑day companion. No hype — just a grounded voice, a moment of stillness, and a look at the world from a quieter angle.

title: Home Turf with Jesse Carlson
author: Jesse Carlson
description:
Every community has people worth knowing.
Home Turf is where those conversations happen. Hosted by Jesse Carlson, the show brings together real estate professionals, business owners, industry experts, and community voices from across the Twin Cities for thoughtful, unscripted conversations about the work they do, the challenges they face, and the ideas shaping the places we call home.
Some episodes dive into housing and entrepreneurship. Others explore local history, leadership, or the stories behind the people making a difference. The common thread isn't the topic; it's the people.

title: The Plus One Club
author: The Plus One Club
description:
Welcome to The Plus One Club - As celebrity plus ones themselves, Sam Richardson’s gf Nicole and Nelson Franklin’s wife Georgia pull back the curtain on what it’s like being in the Plus One Club, chatting with spouses, siblings and best friends of your favorite celebs about how relatable our incredibly unrelatable lives can be. 

They dig into it all - last minute black tie invites, holding down the fort while your partner works out of town, ways we support our best friend’s career, or surviving an international press tour from the sidelines after pitching your own project to those very same people. 

Join us as we explore the uniquely privileged yet surprisingly humbling world of The Plus One Club.


Hosted on Acast. See acast.com/privacy for more information.

title: Pia's Playhouse
author: Mavi Rodriguez
description:
Pia’s Playhouse is an adult storytelling and interview podcast hosted by Pia Polamina.


Each episode opens a different door into Pia’s world, from witty conversations and personal interviews to seductive stories inspired by her own photos. With a mix of sensuality, humor, fantasy, and creative chaos, Pia turns images, ideas, and conversations into intimate audio experiences made to be heard, imagined, and felt.


Whether she’s talking with a guest, narrating erotic fiction, or pulling you into one of her fantasy-driven stories, Pia’s Playhouse is for listeners who enjoy adult storytelling, intimate audio, sensual conversations, and a world that leaves just enough to the imagination.


Want to get closer? Join VIPia for exclusive content, private drops, behind the scenes moments, and more from Pia at https://www.piasplayhouse.com/vipia.


Step inside and listen closer.

title: After the Whistle: Inside BYU Football
author: Zach Halliday, Nate Church
description:
Welcome to After the Whistle, your stats-driven look at BYU football. Join co-hosts Zach Halliday and Nate Church as they go beyond the box score to break down the numbers, matchups and storylines that matter most for the Cougars.
From postgame analysis to in-depth previews, After the Whistle gives BYU fans a deeper understanding of the game and the trends shaping the season.
New postgame recaps every Tuesday throughout the football season, with upcoming game previews every Thursday.

title: The Snap Count
author: Scott Shearer
description:
Listen to The Snap Count with Scott to get the latest predictions and follow along with Scott as he scours the schedule for the next big story, score, or upset. 
Scott is just like you, spending Saturdays watching ball, coaching from the couch, and always trying to think of what's next.
Join Scott and bring your next water cooler talk to the comments as he shares his best opinions that are sure to create debate!

title: Josh Cause
author: Josh Amick
description: Weekly Sports Podcast highlighting the biggest news in the three major sports, NFL, NBA, MLB.

title: Your Daily Spanish Coach
author: Timothy Moser
description: Learn the tactics that elite Spanish coaches use to help serious adult learners become fluent in Spanish. Every weekday, Timothy Moser spends 3 minutes on one technique you can use that day. Episodes cover speaking without freezing, choosing vocabulary you'll actually use, memory devices to make sense of tricky grammar, training your Spanish ear and voice, and study habits you'll follow even on a bad week. It's what he tells his own coaching students at LearnCraft Spanish, built on 12 years of watching what works and what doesn't.

title: Trail To Tide
author: Brooke Moss
description:
Tune in every Wednesday at Noon for an inspiring outdoor show tailored for women, moms, families, and health-conscious outdoorsmen! From serene hiking trails to thrilling boating adventures, Brooke Moss guides you through unforgettable experiences featuring:
Expert tips for fishing, hiking, boating, beaching, and more
Family-friendly outdoor activities and adventures
Conservation stories that inspire sustainable living
Health-focused outdoor tips for active lifestyles

title: Beyond The Break Up With Robin
author: Beyond Th Brreak Up With Robin
description:
Beyond the Breakup with Robin is a podcast about divorce, family law, and what comes next. Hosted by Dallas family law attorney Robin Zegen, the podcast goes beyond the legal process to explore how divorce affects your family, finances, children, and future.

Drawing on more than three decades of family law experience, along with her own experience with divorce, Robin offers practical insights to help you understand your options, make informed decisions, and maintain more control over the process. Episodes explore collaborative divorce, co-parenting, financial concerns, life after divorce, and ways families can resolve conflict without making the courtroom the center of their lives.

Because divorce is not just an ending. It is also the beginning of what comes next.

title: Nature-Based Educator
author: Ade Hofmann
description:
The Nature-Based Director Podcast is for nature-loving, child-centered educators, founders, and directors who want to build and lead thriving nature- and play-based programs without losing themselves in the process.
Whether you're dreaming of starting a nature school, forest school, outdoor preschool, or nature-based early childhood program—or you're already deep in the work of leading one—this podcast offers practical guidance, honest conversations, and encouragement for the real-life challenges of outdoor education and program leadership.
Each episode explores topics like how to start a nature-based program, forest school leadership, outdoor learning, child-led play, enrollment, finances, staffing, policies, behavior and big emotions, teacher burnout, sustainable leadership, and navigating the unexpected as a program founder or director.
Hosted by Ade Hofmann, M.Ed., founder of Nature Play All Day and an educator and leader with nearly a decade of experience in nature-based schools and programs, this podcast is a place for both the practical questions and the things leaders don't always say out loud.
Because building something rooted in nature, play, and community is beautiful—but it can also be lonely, overwhelming, and full of decisions you never expected to make.
Here, you'll find tactical next steps, real-world stories, leadership support, and encouragement to help you move forward with greater clarity and confidence. We'll talk about how to transition from the conventional classroom to outdoor learning, how to start and grow a nature-based program, and how to build sustainable rhythms and routines that support your children, your team, your families, and you.
This work is not about doing it perfectly. It's about learning to trust the process, steward the program you've been entrusted with, and lead without sacrificing yourself in the name of your mission.
If you believe that children belong outside, that play is meaningful learning, and that nature has something powerful to teach us, you're in the right place.

title: Behind the Humidor
author: David's Fine Tobaccos
description: Stay connected with David’s Fine Tobaccos and the premium cigar industry. This podcast covers cigar news, shop updates, tobacco industry trends, product insights, and conversations that help both longtime cigar enthusiasts and newer smokers better understand cigar culture. Get to know David’s Fine Tobaccos, its experience, community, and perspective on what’s happening across the industry. Follow the show for new episodes, updates, and cigar conversations.

title: Bananas History
author: Mem Kennedy
description: Peeling back the layers on how the food we've eaten throughout history has changed us, and the world.

title: What Are We Podcast
author: Noa Solomon & Max Cohen AKA Murray Hill Boy
description:
Every week, Noa Solomon and Max Cohen, aka Murray Hill Boy, unpack the chaos of dating, friendships, internet culture and life as two young, chronically online Jewish New Yorkers trying to figure it all out in real time.
A Lost Tribe original podcast.

title: Breaking Down with Ford Sanders
author: Ford Sanders
description:
Breaking Down with Ford Sanders is your weekly pop culture catch-up with the personality, opinions, and occasional chaos the internet deserves. Former TV news reporter turned internet best friend Ford Sanders covers the biggest viral moments, social media drama, pop culture headlines, and internet discourse everyone's talking about, plus whatever chaos is unfolding in his own life.
Joined by friends, creators, and guests, Ford brings sharp wit, unfiltered opinions, and chaotic honesty to the conversations already happening in your group chat. Because sometimes you need someone to break down the news—and sometimes you just need to break down.

title: Seahawks Triple Option Podcast
author: Emerald City Spectrum
description: The Seahawks Triple Option podcast delivers exclusive insider access and expert perspectives that Seattle Seahawks fans won’t find anywhere else. Hosted by beat reporter Corbin Smith, former NFL running back Robert Turbin, and veteran draft analyst Rob Rang, the podcast brings 12s the deep-dive intel they crave from every imaginable angle, from breaking news out of the VMAC and hard-hitting film room analysis to comprehensive NFL draft scouting and exclusive guest interviews, the Seahawks Triple Option is your ultimate daily look behind the scenes, between the lines, and inside the locker room for the Pacific Northwest’s favorite professional sports franchise. Seahawks Triple Option is a proud part of Emerald City Spectrum, covering All Seattle Sports, All the Time.

title: Which Way, America?
author: whichwayamerica
description: What is happening to the moral fabric of America? What does the future hold for this remarkable nation? Join It Is Written Associate Speaker Eric Flickinger on an unforgettable journey through America’s past, present, and future as he explores the Bible’s most profound prophecies and reveals their relevance to our lives today. A sought-after speaker and host of It Is Written Sabbath School, Eric is able to make the most complex biblical topics accessible and engaging for all.

title: Texas Wesleyan Football
author: Texas Wesleyan Football
description:
Welcome to the official podcast feed for Texas Wesleyan University Football. This is where we drop everything we put on TV — the weekly coaches show and our game broadcasts — so y'all can catch the Rams wherever you are.

Each week you'll get Rams Up, our TV show breaking down the last game, looking ahead to the next one, and getting into the stuff that doesn't show up in a box score — including recurring segments like T.N.T. and Do Your 1/11. Then on game weeks, the full broadcast lands here too, so if you couldn't be in the stands or in front of a TV, you didn't miss it.

Texas Wesleyan football is about more than Saturdays. It's about building better men — on the field, in the classroom, and long after the last snap. Subscribe and follow along.

title: onedegree°
author: Mary Ardath
description:
One Degree is a leadership and personal growth platform designed to inspire, connect, and elevate women who are making an impact in public accounting. 
Built around the belief that extraordinary change often comes from a single decision, mindset shift, or courageous action, #1degree explores the moments that transform careers, businesses, leadership journeys, and lives. 
At 211 degrees, water is hot. At 212 degrees, it boils. onedegree changes everything. 
Every conversation seeks to uncover the onedegree that created meaningful change.

title: The Mysterious Files
author: TheMysteriousFiles
description:
Uncovering the hidden, the haunted, and the historically unexplained.
Join husband-and-wife duo Savannah and Jeff as they dive deep into the world’s most chilling enigmas. From the shadowed hallways of the Hotel Monte Vista to the cold trails of long-forgotten cold cases, Mysterious Files blends meticulous historical research with a passion for paranormal and criminal investigation.
Every episode, Savannah and Jeff peel back the layers of the unknown, exploring everything from lingering spirits in the Jean Harlow House to the gritty details of unsolved true crimes. They aren’t afraid to tackle the cases that haunt our collective memory—from famous hauntings to heartbreaking mysteries like the Little Jane Doe, seeking answers for those who have been forgotten by time.
With Savannah’s background in investigative research and Jeff’s collaborative storytelling, the pair unearths the human history and the baffling injustices left behind in the world’s most mysterious locations. Whether it’s a ghost story, a local legend, or a case that has stumped detectives for decades, they leave no file unopened.
New episodes every week. Grab your flashlight—it’s time to dig into the files.

title: Freep Sports Show
author: Detroit Free Press
description:
The Freep Sports Show is your home for Detroit and Michigan sports! When Dylan Larkin requests a trade, the Tigers send Tarik Skubal packing or the Lions get hosed by a ref, we'll be there with you to react. 
Hosted by longtime Detroit Free Press columnist Shawn Windsor and Freep sports staffer Andrew Birkle, the Freep Sports Show is our first major step in revamping how we get our award-winning content to you, the audience.
So what makes this podcast different than the millions of others that are out there? The answer is simple: We've got the best team of experts in local sports just a phone call away.
Dave Birkett (Lions), Helene St. James (Red Wings), Omari Sankofa II (Pistons), Chris Solari (Michigan State athletics), Tony Garcia (Michigan athletics), Jared Ramsey (high school sports), Christian Romo (trending news), Rainer Sabin (college football and NFL), and our team of legendary columnists (Shawn Windsor, Carlos Monarrez and Jeff Seidel) give us a never-ending rolodex of insiders ready to roll at a moment's notice.
If you've been searching far and wide for the right podcast that will discuss ALL your favorite teams in the Mitten State, look no further. We can't wait for you to join us, as we pride ourselves on engaging with commenters on livestreams and interacting as much as possible.
Join us for three shows a week, including a LIVE reaction show after every Detroit Lions game this season.
You can find every episode of the Freep Sports Show on Apple Podcasts, Spotify or YouTube. For more, visit freep.com/sports.

title: Teacher Chatter
author: Dr Neeraja Raghavan
description:
This platform is for exchanging views on teaching and learning.

It is targeted at teachers, parents, students ...anybody who learns, has learnt and loves learning.

Although it was started in India, exchanges are sought from all over the world.


In the first episode, six teachers tell us why they became teachers.

description: The MoveU podcast empowers people to live pain-free, healthy lives by providing comprehensive educational conversations, resources, and tools to optimize movement, alignment, mindset, and recovery.

title: Grandparenting Today's Teens
author: Mark Gregston
description:
Teens today are stuffed with information and starving for wisdom. They act distant, but they need you more than ever.
Grandparenting Today's Teens is a weekly podcast for grandparents who want to stay connected to the teenagers they love. Mark Gregston has worked with struggling adolescents for more than 45 years, and thousands of them have lived in his home. Each week he explains what today's teen culture is doing to your grandkids, and what you can do about it.
Your gray hair is an asset. Your years give you something their friends and their phones cannot. You may be the one voice that counters everything else pulling at them.
Mark covers how to connect across the generation gap, how to support your grandkids without overstepping your adult children, how to make memories that outlast you, and how to keep reaching a teenager's heart even when their behavior hurts yours.
You can be the connection that offers hope. Your life can change their life, and change the destiny of your family.
Visit ParentingTodaysTeens.org for more resources.

title: The Scot Ferrell Show
author: Scot Ferrell
description:
Now back and stronger than ever, he’s on a mission to deliver “the wake-up call you didn’t ask for”—helping viewers confront reality, overcome obstacles, and take control of their lives. From relationships and family struggles to business and personal growth, no topic is off-limits.


Real talk. Real struggle. Real comeback.


If you’ve ever felt stuck, broken, or ready to quit—this podcast is for you.
Tune in and discover why giving up is never an option.

description:
What became possible once you stopped hiding your work?

That's the question at the center of every conversation on The Visibility Effect. Hosted by Jay LaPointe of J. August Media, this series goes deep with entrepreneurs, creatives, and business leaders on what shifted when they chose visibility over silence.

The work does not speak for itself. You have to give it a voice.

Hosted by Jay Lapointe | Visibility Strategist | J. August Media

title: Cher-ing Grief Podcast
author: Cher
description:
Welcome to the club no one wants to join, hosted by a grieving daughter with spicy brain and a dark sense of humor. It is a candid take of life after losing my mom. There may be some some wild rabbit holes, laughs at awkward parts of mourning, and spooky signs that loved ones haven't truly left. It's comforting, it's chaotic, and it's proof that grief can be hilarious, heartbreaking, and haunting all at once.
Let's have a gander: https://cheringgriefpod.substack.com
